overall_assessment: All four pre-pass flags are false alarms: the DID lines describe music-didactics topics, GRUSKU5100 has a complete one-line materials note, and VERK2100 has a legitimate bibliography. The 16 random controls reveal recurring teaching activities filed under course content and occasional elective administration, while assessment retains recurring resit rules across both samples. Learning-outcome groups and explicit PPU exam-entry gates are preserved in the visible material, with two source-plan tails capped by the packet builder.

findings.evidence:
Individuell undervisning med hovedinstrumentlærer
Akkompagnement med instituttets akkompagnatør
findings.description: Six random controls file delivery activities such as individual lessons, workshops and independent rehearsals under course_content. HINS2200 consists entirely of such activities in that row, while KAM4300 includes both repertoire categories and delivery activities.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Barratt Due override in R/institution_config.R sends the whole Undervisning og læringsformer column to course_content.
findings.suggested_fix: Route the recurring HINS lesson and performance activity lines and KAM workshop, group instruction and rehearsal lists to teaching_methods. Preserve subject entries such as Stemmeanatomi and repertoire categories in course_content.

findings.evidence: Krav til forkunnskaper: Bachelorgrad i musikk og Opptak til Praktisk-pedagogisk utdanning
findings.description: DID1 has no prerequisites row even though its prerequisite field specifies a completed degree in music alongside admission to the programme. The specification keeps a mixed requirement together when it names academic preparation and admission.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The positive prerequisite pattern and the generic degree exclusion in .admission_prerequisites() in R/extract_sections.R can reject this subject-specific degree clause.
findings.suggested_fix: Recognize Bachelorgrad i musikk followed by the PPU admission clause in the Barratt Due prerequisite field. Retain the whole requirement under the mixed-sentence rule and continue filtering bare programme admission.

findings.evidence: Den delen som ikke er bestått må gjennomføres på nytt. Deretter gis det ny samlet vurdering.
findings.description: Assessment retains resit policy across suspects and controls. Three PPU plans repeat the same failed-component policy. Other recurring forms instruct students to repeat all or part of the course or restate the ordinary assessment format as a resit.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: Ny vurdering maps to assessment. The Barratt Due cleanup in R/extract_sections.R removes individual decision and examiner language but leaves these recurring resit instructions.
findings.suggested_fix: Use the Ny vurdering heading to identify resit text before section consolidation. Remove the recurring failed-component and course-repeat policies and resit lines that only repeat the ordinary form. Keep any distinct assessment design.

findings.evidence: Opptak i emnet forutsetter at kriterier som besetning og repertoar oppfylles på bakgrunn av søkermasse og tilgjengelig undervisningsressurs.
findings.description: Course content retains elective admission and capacity language in KAMFOR5100 and student priority and staff allocation rules in SPIN5110.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Barratt Due heading override routes the prose to course_content and the cleanup leaves the elective-allocation sentences in that section.
findings.suggested_fix: Filter the explicit elective-admission sentence in KAMFOR5100 and the priority and allocation sentences in SPIN5110 from the Barratt Due course_content row. Preserve the programme subject and repertoire text.

findings.evidence: Kurset gir innføring i grunnleggende formell akademisk skriving og en grunnleggende innføring i bruk av KI.
findings.description: The HIST1100 coursework row contains three sentences on what the academic-writing module teaches, including AI use and artistic development work in performance. Those details are absent from course_content. The following weekly assignments and approval condition are genuine coursework requirements.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Arbeidskrav mapping leaves the entire mixed Akademisk skriving paragraph in coursework_requirements.
findings.suggested_fix: For the HIST1100 academic-writing paragraph, move the subject-description sentences before Det gis 1-3 korte, ukentlige oppgaver to course_content. Keep the assignments and their approval condition in coursework_requirements.

findings.evidence: Avsluttende essay på mellom 1600 og 2000 ord basert på erfaringer med teknikken gjennom emnet
findings.description: The portfolio explicitly assesses the written assignments and final essay, but the assessment row gives only their general names. The number of assignments and the essay length and subject are available solely in the coursework row, where these submissions also have an explicit approval requirement.
findings.root_cause_hypothesis: The Arbeidskrav and Vurderingsformer heading mappings do not link the brief portfolio description to the listed submissions it assesses.
findings.suggested_fix: When the Barratt Due portfolio explicitly assesses the same named assignments and essay, place their verbatim submission specifications with assessment and retain the explicit approval condition in coursework_requirements.
